$comment: GOLD pipeline-prompt: the required inputs and expected output of the mock-data-author agent (UXP-540). Hand-authored reference showing the add-vs-create EXTEND path (clf-018). Output conforms to docs/product-truth/schemas/mock-data.schema.json. The agent NEVER creates a second dataset for an entity a component already has — it extends the one canonical dataset in place.
purpose: Draft or EXTEND the one canonical dataset for the classified entities — realistic records the mockups and flow are built on, never a duplicate dataset.

classification.user_request: Add a 'care level' (easy/medium/hard) field to plants.

search_result.match_basis: by_component=ux-prototyping AND by_entity=Plant already resolves to fern-and-fig/catalog

changes.entities.Plant.records[*].care_level: each existing Plant record gains a realistic care_level value

fields.name: string
fields.status: enum: in-stock | low-stock | out-of-stock (derived from stock)

provenance.note: Added Plant.care_level (easy/medium/hard) to the canonical catalog dataset — extended in place, not duplicated.

rules: ALWAYS search index.json (by_component + by_entity) before writing — the add-vs-create decision from the classifier is a proposal you re-verify against the store.
If a canonical dataset exists for these entities in this component: EXTEND it in place — add fields/records, bump version, append provenance, keep the id. NEVER create a second file.
Only CREATE a new <product>/<name>.mock.json when no canonical dataset exists for the entities.
Every entity key MUST be a member of index.json entity_registry.
Records must satisfy the dataset's invariants[] (e.g. Plant.status is derived from stock); keep new records realistic and consistent, not placeholder text.

Do NOT hand-edit the derived index maps (by_component / by_entity / by_flow / by_ac) or any impl_status / impl_summary — after writing the artifact and registering it in index.json artifacts[], run docs/product-truth/scripts/generate_product_truth.py to rebuild the derived data, then validate_product_truth.py.
